make.description: Italian supercar maker owned by the Volkswagen Group through Audi. It has no battery-electric car on sale; its announced first BEV, the Lanzador, was turned into a hybrid project in 2026.

models.name: Lanzador
models.description: Raised 2+2 grand tourer revealed as a concept at Monterey Car Week on 18 August 2023 and announced as Lamborghini's first production battery-electric car for 2028. In 2026 the battery-electric version was cancelled and the project switched to a hybrid powertrain.

generations.name: Battery-electric (cancelled)
generations.description: Planned dual-motor BEV; never built in battery-electric form.
